title: The Science and Wisdom of Limits

sourceEvidence.excerpt: week shared by twelve-year-old Matei and his grandfather in 2094. Asked to propose one rule for humanity’s future, Matei initially imagines artificial intelligences calculating the best outcomes while people intervene only when the machines disagree. His grandfather does not counter with a lecture. Instead, he takes the boy through a Systems Archive, an energy cooperative, a civic modeling center, a regional water deliberation, and a planetary observatory while a solar storm approaches Earth.
